versioning_policy: Questions are never deleted. A question that becomes outdated is marked status 'deprecated' or 'superseded', kept in the bank and in git history, and replaced by a new versioned question. Corrections bump the question version and are recorded in CHANGELOG.md.

changelog.note: D3-AGENT-023 re-sourced from 'What are agent identities?' to 'Microsoft Agent 365 overview' (learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-agent-365/overview), bumped to version 3: the overview states verbatim the 1 May 2026 GA date, per-user licensing, and E5 as the recommended prerequisite, which the old page did not. The weakly sourced 'base Agent ID identity object is free' clause was reworded to the Entra page's own wording, 'available for all Microsoft Entra customers'. No count changed (still 1020); 134 distinct source pages.

Citation corrections for the v2026.11.2 caveats (10 questions, version bumped to 2): D3-AI-039 re-sourced to 'Configure AI Gateway in your Foundry resources'; D4-BKP-044 re-sourced to the Azure Blueprints retirement FAQ; Entra Agent ID quotes replaced with verbatim Learn text, D3-AGENT-021/037 re-sourced to 'Secure autonomous agents with Conditional Access', D3-AGENT-004 re-sourced to the Learn grant-controls page with the unsupported 'Block (or Allow)' wording corrected to Block only. 134 distinct source pages.

Bank grown to 1020 hard questions (all difficulty hard), in per-topic files under data/topics/ (23 topics). All 200 original questions re-verified against Microsoft Learn / Azure docs, upgraded to hard scenario style, and given source_url, source_title and source_quote. 131 distinct official source pages cited. Gaps from v2026.11.1 now covered: Azure Backup security, IaC governance, Virtual Network Manager, Virtual WAN, Entra Private Access, Logic Apps, Container Instances / Container Apps.
Full syllabus, Learn-only: 200 questions, 100 standard / 100 hard, 4 domains.
